record.question: Which institution publishes the Inclusive Development Index (IDI)?
record.explanation: Answer C: World Economic Forum. The World Economic Forum published the Inclusive Development Index. Reference: https://www.weforum.org/reports/the-inclusive-growth-and-development-report-2017/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
